producer_report.summary: Reworded the t3 trigger to "the agent records a ready PR or a ready branch for the task". The cited claims support this: c32 says a ship records its ready PR, and c11 and c37 cover the ready PR or branch. It no longer says the agent accepts the worker's report. Fixed the missing space before "trigger_evaluated_by" on t3, t8, t10 and t11. Replaced the keyword-ban site test with a structural one: every agent-decided trigger must have "the agent" as its subject, and no other trigger may. Added a CHANGELOG entry. Root cause: the old test banned a few event words, so it missed wording the claims did not support, and the t3 trigger was never checked against its claims. I did not edit claims.json because no claim needed changing.

checks_run.note: 33 unit tests and all integration tests passed
